drawings.description: en marge gauche, au bas de la page, une figure : du point $u$, l'arc de grand cercle vers $x(u,v;\alpha)$ et celui vers $x(u,v';\alpha)$, l'angle $\theta$ entre eux marqué près de $u$ ; un trait épais joint $u$ au centre, d'où partent en tirets les rayons vers les deux points $x$, l'angle $\alpha$ marqué près du centre ; en bas, les vecteurs $v$, $v'$, $w$ issus du centre, un arc passant par leurs extrémités et l'angle $\theta$ entre $v$ et $v'$.
drawings.kind: spherical triangle from u with the vectors v, v', w
drawings.notes: Small ink figure in the left margin. From the point u, two arcs, to x(u,v;alpha) above and to x(u,v';alpha) at the left, both ending at the one point u; a small arc between them near u and the letter theta; a heavy stroke from u down to the centre; from the centre, dash-dotted radii to the two points x; alpha written near the centre, with two small arcs there. Below: three strokes from the centre to v, v' and w (arrowheads at v and w), an arc through the three ends, theta between v and v' with its small arc. All strokes from the centre start at one computed point. Still differs: the small arcs marking alpha are a reading of a few crowded strokes (he hatches a small fan there); the dash-dotted radius to x(u,v;alpha) is visible only in its upper part on the page and is drawn whole. The transcription's note has theta « près des sommets »: one theta near u and one below between v and v' are seen. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, issue 147, overlay check: not compiled (no TeX in the session); the TikZ was rasterised by a local interpreter and laid over the scan rendered at 400 dpi. Nothing changed. The strokes, arcs and points lie on their ink to within about one unit at the scale of the figure; it stays partial for the reading of the crowded small arcs and of the dash-dotted radius named above.

drawings.kind: circle divided by radii (division in five)
drawings.notes: A circle drawn as one stroke open at the left (from the top left round by the right and the bottom to the lower left), and the strokes from one inner point, slightly left of and below the centre: towards the top (to the outline), to the right (to the outline), to the lower right (stops short of the outline), to the lower left (heavy and doubled, one of its two strokes overshooting the outline, where a short tick crosses it: the small cross), to the upper left (short and faint, stops well short), and a sixth, horizontal, to the left as far as where the outline would be. At the upper left, where the outline is not drawn, two short strokes (a tick with a bar). Between the right-hand radius and the lower right one, a second arc runs inside the outline. Disagreement in part with the transcription's note (« partagé par cinq rayons »): six strokes leave the centre; five of them are spaced by about 72 degrees, the sixth (horizontal, to the left) is extra. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128). Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): six strokes leave the inner point: five about 72 degrees apart and a sixth, horizontal, to the left as far as the outline; the drawing stands. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, issue 147, overlay check: not compiled (no TeX in the session); the TikZ was rasterised by a local interpreter and laid over the 236 ppi scan rendered at 400 dpi. Redrawn on the ink: the outline through points moved onto its ink (the fitted ellipse was up to five units off at the bottom), every stroke fitted by least squares on its own ink; each lies on its ink to within about one unit. Changed: the outline is drawn as the page's open stroke, not as an ellipse; the heavy stroke to the lower left is two strokes; the cross at its end is the tick across the longer one; the doubled arc is one inner arc. Not checked by a reader.

drawings.description: feuillet de carnet à spirale, en largeur, couvert d'une trentaine de croquis à l'encre et au crayon, mêlés de formules : fleurs à trois, quatre ou cinq pétales, dont l'une, en marge gauche, est légendée « corolle », « racine », « tige », « cœur », « pétale » ; une fleur à trois lobes à côté d'un disque noirci ; tétraèdres et pyramides, dont l'un, au crayon, avec un point intérieur relié aux sommets ; un losange à diagonales suivi d'un « $G$ » ; un hexagone découpé en six triangles, relié par un arc à un point près du « $G$ » et légendé « $\mathrm{O}(3)$ », « $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ » ; une suite de trois ovales emboîtés dont le plus intérieur porte « $u_1$ » et « $u_0$ » cerclé ; un carré inscrit dans un quadrilatère, reliés par les diagonales ; un graphe en forme de cube aplati, à sommets marqués de ronds, de croix et de points ; un cube dont trois faces sont fléchées vers un sommet ; un gros « 8 ».
drawings.kind: notebook leaf covered with sketches (flowers, polyhedra, nested ovals, graph of the cube)
drawings.notes: Whole leaf redrawn, each sketch at its place (1 unit = 1.8 mm): about thirty sketches in ink and pencil among formulas. Extended on 2026-11-12 from the eight sketches of the first redraw to all those that can be read; the coordinates of the first eight were read again on tighter crops. Drawn: the flower of the left margin with its legends (heart, two petals and a narrow heavy one between them, stem ending in a dot, the oval of the root; corolle, racine, tige, cœur, pétale along the margin); the four-petalled flower and its stalk; the small pencil tetrahedron of the top row (inner point joined to the three vertices) and the lens under it; two pencil ovals crossed by two strokes; the pencil wedge over the chain 4 -> 3 -> 2; the pencil circle with an angle inside and the cornet beside it; a faint circle with an arc below; the heavy loop holding a small tetrahedron; the rhombus with diagonals and « G »; the three-lobed flower and the blackened disc (hatched); the hexagon cut into six triangles, two of its radii and one side heavy, inside a leaf whose stalk ends at the dot near « G », with « O(3) », « SO(3) »; the pyramid of the top right (five marked points and two small rings, apex below); a faint rounded outline in the top right corner; the flower with four angular petals and the heavy stroke beside it; the three nested ovals with u_1 and the circled u_0; a small lens and a cross; the square inside a quadrilateral, corners joined, with its two rows of hatchings and the lens inside; the pencil flower with five petals and the curved arrow; the graph of the cube (outer square, inner square, corners joined) with its vertices marked by rings, crosses, a dot and a double ring; the cube seen from a corner, three faces with arrows towards the common vertex; the heavy « 8 »; the two touching discs; two faint ovals with a heavy bar; the four small figures of the bottom row (a pyramid on a quadrilateral, a tetrahedron with an inner point, an oval with a chord, a circle), each with a stroke above it; the large pencil tetrahedron; the heavy pyramid of the bottom right (apex below, one diagonal of the base). Not drawn: the formulas, the chain 4 -> 3 -> 2 -> 1 -> 0, « 8 × 6 », the unfinished sign with « 789 », a heavy « Z – » over the hexagon (letters), the blackened blot beside « ≃ E » (a deletion); and, too faint to read, a pencil cross of two axes with a dot left of the rhombus, some vertical pencil strokes beside it, a short pencil arrow right of the heavy loop, and pencil arcs left of the square figure. Readings decided on the page (2026-11-12, machine pass, not checked by a reader): the nested ovals are three, and both u_1 and the circled u_0 are inside the innermost; the graph with marked vertices has eight vertices and twelve edges (the graph of the cube), not six vertices; the large pencil tetrahedron holds an inner triangle, one corner of it marked by a small ring, whose corners are joined to the outer vertices (the first redraw gave one inner point joined to the three vertices). Still differs: lobes, petals and pencil outlines are smooth curves through a few read points, to about one unit; doubled strokes are drawn once; the faint pencil ovals are fitted ellipses; in the large pencil tetrahedron the joins of the inner triangle to the outer vertices are a reading of faint strokes that run close to the outer sides; line weights are a reading. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): the nested ovals are three and both u_1 and the circled u_0 are inside the innermost one; the drawing stands. Not checked by a reader. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): the graph with rings and crosses has eight vertices (a square inside a square, corners joined, twelve edges); it is now drawn. Not checked by a reader. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, issue 147, overlay check: not compiled (no TeX in the session); the TikZ was rasterised by a local interpreter and laid over the scan rendered at 400 dpi. Nothing changed. At the scale of the whole leaf (9 pixels per unit) the sketches lie on their ink to within about one to two units, the faint pencil ovals and circles (among them the large ones at the left and at the lower middle) to within about two to three; not checked sketch by sketch in this pass, and partial for the readings named above.

drawings.description: au centre, la projection de l'icosaèdre sur le plan orthogonal à un axe : un décagone inscrit dans un cercle au crayon, dont les sommets portent, dans le sens des aiguilles d'une montre à partir du haut à gauche, $A_1, A'_3, A_0, A'_2, A_4, A'_1, A_3, A'_0, A_2, A'_4$ (plusieurs lettres récrites, $A$ par-dessus $\alpha$ ; $\alpha_0$ est resté tel) ; le centre marqué $s'$ et $s$ ; les deux pentagones $A_i$ et $A'_i$ tracés, celui des $A_i$ avec le côté $A_0A_4$ très appuyé, et les dix rayons, celui de $A_2$ appuyé, celui de $A'_2$ en pointillé, celui de $A'_4$ en tirets.
drawings.kind: projection of the icosahedron: decagon with two pentagons and radii
drawings.notes: Ten vertices read on his figure (it is not quite regular) and every edge drawn between these same ten points and the one centre: the ten sides of the decagon (heavy: A_1 A'_3, A'_1 A_3, A_2 A'_0), the pentagon A_1 A_0 A_4 A_3 A_2 (its side A_0 A_4 very heavy), the pentagon A'_3 A'_2 A'_1 A'_0 A'_4 (faint; the side A'_0 A'_4 broken), the ten radii (to A_2 heavy, to A'_2 dotted, to A'_4 dashed, to A'_3 and A'_1 faint), the pencil circle around, the centre marked s' (above) and s (below). Labels outside the vertices, as on the page; the letter at the upper right is his alpha_0, not rewritten into A_0. DISAGREEMENT with the transcription's note, which gives the cyclic order A_1, A'_3, A_0, A'_2, A_4, A'_1, A_2, A'_0, A_3, A'_4: on the page the vertex at the bottom is A_3 and the vertex at the left is A_2 (so that both pentagons run with indices decreasing by one clockwise); the mark gives the order of the page. Still differs: line weights are a reading of pencil strokes gone over several times; the overwritten primes and indices of A'_1 and A'_4 (a 1 and a 4 written one over the other at the lower right; a 2 and a 4 at the upper left) are read with the help of the cyclic order. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (maths): the cyclic order is A_1, A'_3, A_0, A'_2, A_4, A'_1, A_3, A'_0, A_2, A'_4: the left letter reads A_2 on the page, the bottom one has a 3 and a 2 written one over the other, and only A_3 at the bottom lets the pentagon A_1 A_0 A_4 A_3 A_2 run with indices decreasing by one, as the pentagon of the A' does; the drawing stands. Not checked by a reader. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): the upper right letter is alpha_0, left as written and not rewritten into A_0; the drawing stands. Not checked by a reader. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, issue 147, overlay check: not compiled (no TeX in the session); the TikZ was rasterised by a local interpreter and laid over the scan rendered at 400 dpi. Nothing changed. The decagon, the two pentagons and the diagonals lie on their ink to within about one unit; it stays partial for the overwritten primes and indices, read with the help of the cyclic order.
drawings.disagreement: The note of the transcription gives the vertices in the order A_1, A'_3, A_0, A'_2, A_4, A'_1, A_2, A'_0, A_3, A'_4; on the page the bottom vertex reads A_3 and the left one A_2: A_1, A'_3, A_0, A'_2, A_4, A'_1, A_3, A'_0, A_2, A'_4.
